name: KUEPER Relation Registry — Narrative World Shard

definitions.description: Links a canonical temporal state to the stable canonical entity whose state it describes.
Links a canonical event to an entity it affects in a canonically relevant way.
Links a canonical event to a canonical state whose validity begins as a consequence of the event.
Links a canonical event to a canonical state whose validity ends because of the event.
Links a canonical participant entity to a canonical event.
Links a canonical event to its canonical primary location when such a location is known.

nonGraphMappingRelations.description: Maps a consumer runtime identifier to a canonical KG identifier. Runtime identifiers are not KG entities, therefore PROJECTS_TO is not stored as a normal REL edge.
